title: PqStatusView
description: The Security screen's post-quantum status line, as the desktop's `pq_status` command and the web vault's `pq_status` call answer it (lockdown_app::pq_status::PqStatusView; docs/plan/30-pq-status-line.md). Fields are only added under D62. A device is named by its id and the name the Devices screen shows, nothing else.

reason.description: Why the state is unknown; null otherwise.

without_level_1.description: Devices that don't read the account's post-quantum key yet. Empty unless waiting.

without_level_2.description: Devices that read the account's key but not post-quantum vault heads yet; never also in without_level_1. Empty unless waiting.
